left.title: Sorting through the mess in Virginia
left.body: Virginia law spells out how to replace a governor — but the cascading scandals hitting state officials make everything more complicated.
left.roundup: The political upheaval in Virginia intensified on Wednesday as Attorney General Mark Herring admitted to wearing blackface in college and an accuser released a statement detailing allegations of sexual assault against Lt. Gov. Justin Fairfax.

center.title: Fairfax accuser says consensual situation 'quickly turned into a sexual assault'
center.body: Vanessa Tyson, a professor who has accused Virginia Lt. Gov. Justin Fairfax (D) of sexual assault, issued her first statement Wednesday detailing her allegation against him.

right.title: Another one: Virginia AG Mark Herring admits to wearing blackface in 1980
right.body: Virginia Attorney General Mark Herring, a Democrat, admitted Wednesday to wearing blackface at a college party in 1980, further ensnaring the state’s leadership in chaos.
